source_method: Official NCCP PDF text retrieved through web extraction; source tables reviewed.
limitations: Direct NCCP PDF binary requests were blocked; official web-extracted text and page/table citations were reviewed.
Source review is not independent consultant or oncology-pharmacy verification.
UK manufacturer information is a labelled supplementary comparator, not a silent replacement of NCCP.

changes: Metastatic maintenance setting

changes: QTcF 480–500 interval and explicit restart-source conflict

Lung toxicity and practical tablet-strength review
NCCP eligibility wording discrepancies
